description: Na₂MnH₄(SO₅)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-3.00 Å. Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.18-2.25 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.00 Å) and one longer (1.66 Å) H-O bond length. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-50°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.47-1.51 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na, one Mn, and two H atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mn, and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mn, and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one H, and one S atom.
